components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one prominent action in a focused flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; width: 100%; height: 3.5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--auth-button-border); border-radius: 0.6rem; background: var(--auth-button-bg); padding: 0 1rem; color: var(--auth-button-text); font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #765256; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b82b49; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A compact secondary action that does not compete with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 0.7rem; background: rgb(127 90 95 / 0.13); padding: 0 1rem; color: var(--auth-brand); font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 800; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: rgb(127 90 95 / 0.19); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b82b49; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Warm Text Field
components.description: The canonical field for setup and focused forms.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-name">SPACE NAME</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-name" placeholder="Our story" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.55rem; color: var(--auth-brand); font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 3.35rem; border: 1px solid rgb(125 88 93 / 0.2); border-radius: 0.8rem; background: #f6f2ee; padding: 0 1rem; color: var(--auth-heading); font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(125 88 93 / 0.38); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--auth-brand); outline: none; background: #fffaf7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(127 90 95 / 0.12); }

components.name: Memory Card
components.description: A framed memory summary where photography and editorial title carry the emotion.

components.css: .ds-memory-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #eee6e3; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: #fff; color: var(--auth-heading); } .ds-memory-cover { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: #fff4f3; transition: transform 240ms ease-out; } .ds-memory-card:hover .ds-memory-cover { transform: scale(1.025); } .ds-memory-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #b82b49; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-memory-body { padding: 1rem; } .ds-memory-date { color: #9b7779; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-memory-body h3 { margin: 0.7rem 0 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-memory-body p { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; color: #554b4a; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Setup Tabs
components.description: A quiet two-option selector with an editorial active state.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(125 88 93 / 0.18); } .ds-tab { position: relative; min-height: 3.25rem; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0 0.6rem; color: var(--auth-copy); font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; transition: color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--auth-brand); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b82b49; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--auth-brand); } .ds-tab-active::after { position: absolute; right: 12%; bottom: -1px; left: 12%; height: 2px; background: var(--auth-brand); content: ''; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: The persistent application navigation shown from the medium breakpoint.
components.html: MemoriesTimelinePrivate VaultSettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; width: 14.25rem; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 1.75rem 1rem; border-right: 1px solid #e9dfdd; background: rgb(255 253 252 / 0.5); } .ds-nav a { display: flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; border-radius: 0.55rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; color: #584648; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav-active { background: #e8e4e2; color: #7f3d4a; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b82b49; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav a:active { transform: scale(0.99); }

narrative.overview:
Leonly should feel like a carefully kept object shared by two people: warm, tactile, intimate, and quietly premium. Blush paper-like surfaces, framed photography, editorial headings, and restrained burgundy actions give persisted memories emotional weight without turning the product into a public scrapbook.

The interface stays calm and dependable. Generous whitespace and soft layers support reflection, while clear hierarchy, honest states, and conventional controls keep private workflows easy to use. Expression belongs in meaningful imagery and precise details, not decorative UI noise.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces rather than cold gray application chrome.
Editorial Fraunces headings paired with sturdy Nunito Sans controls and copy.
One scarce burgundy primary action, with lavender reserved for private-vault context.
Photography treated as content through deliberate framing and aspect ratios.
Soft, purposeful motion with complete reduced-motion behavior.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use burgundy for the single primary action in a view; never introduce a competing saturated call-to-action color.

rules.name: The Private Lavender Rule
rules.body: Lavender signals vault context or quiet categorization. It never replaces burgundy as the product's primary voice.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Fraunces for emotional hierarchy and Nunito Sans for operation. Do not introduce a third font family.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow must clarify layer or interaction state. Use a warm border or tonal surface when elevation is not semantically necessary.

dos: Do reuse semantic variables and existing primitives before adding a token or component.
Do give each view one obvious burgundy primary action and quiet secondary actions.
Do preserve mobile bottom navigation, desktop sidebar, logical source order, and safe-area padding.
Do define honest empty, loading, unavailable, error, and success states using persisted product truth.
Do keep interactions between 160ms and 300ms and provide equivalent reduced-motion behavior.
Do use semantic landmarks, ordered headings, explicit labels, keyboard-operable controls, and visible focus states.
donts: Don't introduce cold SaaS dashboard chrome, dense data tables, or hard pure-black contrast.
Don't add glassmorphism, unrelated gradients, generic stock-shadcn styling, or a third font.
Don't use lavender as the main call-to-action color or create multiple saturated CTAs.
Don't shadow every element, overuse pills, or add decorative motion without purpose.
Don't fabricate memories, people, places, metrics, testimonials, or proof.
Don't change global tokens, shared primitives, or navigation patterns without an approved design reason and coverage of existing consumers.
